# Issue #21: feat(ui): Implement Options Settings Dashboard and GitHub Repository Management

- **State**: `CLOSED`
- **Labels**: `type: feature`, `area: ui`
- **URL**: `https://github.com/Inkesk-Dozing/LeetLogger/issues/21`

---

Build the full onboarding and settings dashboard for repository configuration and sync management.



## Objectives

- Tabbed settings dashboard built with React 18 (`src/ui/welcome/App.tsx`).

- GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT) and OAuth authentication flows.

- Dynamic repository selector with automatic new repository creation.

- Synchronization preferences (auto-sync toggle, commit message format, root README generation).

- Historical sync trigger with progress bar and statistics display.



## Tasks

- [x] Build welcome and options dashboard UI.

- [x] Implement GitHub account linking and token validation.

- [x] Build repository selection and creation workflow.
